note1_00_02: Native installed macOS Desktop App window (bin/MyReminderDesktopApp via NSWindow + WKWebView) installed in /Applications/MyReminder Control.app and /Users/Hasan/Desktop/MyReminder Control.app, real macOS Notification Center system banners with sound (src/send-macos-system-notification.js via osascript), installable PWA manifest & service worker (/manifest.webmanifest, /sw.js, public/js/register-pwa-and-notifications.js), and statusBar-level native full-screen alert window with auto-close.
